scientific_integrity: Structural proof, exact counting and independently implemented finite instance checks; claims of novelty are qualified, and independent external verification has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Minimum counts aggregated implications only among simultaneous one-round systems, not arbitrary iterative systems; no Möbius or homotopy classification. Finite tests are corroboration of an all-parameter proof. Unindexed equivalent literature is possible.
title: Hamiltonian-cycle incidence closure: exact closed sets and optimal one-round Horn bases
